title: Why Constrained Updates Still Forget: A Functional-Path Analysis of Continual SFT
abstract: arXiv:2610.30191v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning adapts language models to specialized tasks but can disrupt previously acquired behavior. Existing approaches constrain parameters, gradients, or replay objectives, yet the connection between the protected object, the intervening trajectory, and retained outputs remains unclear. We develop a functional-path account that decomposes old-loss changes along realized updates into the controlled direction, gradient staleness, probe mismatch, and finite-step effects. The account yields a conditional refresh budget and identifies the restoring direction supplied by informative replay. Matched QLoRA interventions separate constraint granularity from placement before or after Adam: placement strongly affects retention across the studied code-label audits, whereas the granularity interaction depends on the endpoint. translated_title: 为什么受约束的更新仍然会遗忘：持续监督微调的函数路径分析
translated_abstract: 监督微调使语言模型适应专门任务，但可能会破坏其先前习得的行为。现有方法通过约束参数、梯度或重放目标来缓解这一问题，然而受保护对象、实际干预轨迹与保留输出之间的联系仍不清晰。我们发展了一种函数路径分析框架，将实际更新所引起的旧损失变化分解为受控方向、梯度陈旧性、探针失配和有限步效应四个组成部分。该框架给出了一个条件性的刷新预算，并识别出信息性重放所提供的恢复方向。通过匹配的QLoRA干预实验，我们将约束粒度与放置位置（位于Adam之前或之后）分离开来：在所研究的代码标签审计中，放置位置强烈影响旧能力的保留效果，而粒度的交互作用则取决于端点状态。检查点生成实验将端点恢复与更高的采样路径准确率区分开来，匹配的重放方案……
tldr: 该论文提出“函数路径”分析框架，将持续微调导致的遗忘分解为受控方向、梯度陈旧性、探针失配与有限步效应四个因素，并通过匹配的QLoRA干预实验揭示约束放置在Adam之前还是之后对旧能力保留的影响远大于约束粒度本身。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a functional-path framework that decomposes forgetting in continual SFT into controlled direction, gradient staleness, probe mismatch, and finite-step effects, showing through matched QLoRA interventions that placement before or after Adam—rather than constraint granularity—strongly determines retention of prior capabilities.
